'''Labio''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] who managed the [[Starwind Chandlery]], a general store and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] outfitter that was on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[StarForge Station]]. Tired and old<ref name="Orbit" /> by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{FarOrbitDate}}</ref> the Devaronian worked with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mioe]] and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Wurrooba]], who were both clerks there.<ref name="Orbit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Labio first appeared in ''[[Preparing for War]]'', an adventure scenario from [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and was a sequel of sorts to the previous publication, ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', carrying on that book's theme by following the [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] [[Frigate/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Far Orbit]]''. Labio was not given a [[Gender/Legends|gender]] in the book.<ref name="Orbit" />
